On a freshly initialized C, repay always reverts for any debtPositionId, because no debt position exists yet (or is already fully repaid).
A successful initialize on a fresh Size contract grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE, KEEPER_ROLE and BORROW_RATE_UPDATER_ROLE to the given owner and to nobody else, for any valid parameter set.
After a successful initialize on a fresh Size contract, the given owner holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE while the deploying test contract does not hold it, for any valid parameter set.
After a successful initialize, the owner holds the PAUSER_ROLE and can use it to pause, so `paused()` becomes true; the deploying test contract never holds PAUSER_ROLE.
After a successful initialize with the test contract as owner, the owner holds PAUSER_ROLE and can pause, so paused() becomes true.
After a successful initialize on a fresh Size contract, only the PAUSER_ROLE holder (the owner) can pause, so calling pause() as the owner sets paused() to true.
